description: NIH RxNorm concept lookup (RxNav): RxCUI identifiers for a drug name with each concept's name and term type (e.g. IN = ingredient, SCD = clinical drug). Up to 5 concepts per call. Exact-name lookup, no fuzzy matching. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

name.description: Drug or ingredient name, letters, digits, spaces and hyphens, 2 to 100 characters
